blocks.content: Quiz: What keyword creates a new instance of a class?
Tap an option below to answer:
create
Incorrect, give it another shot!
There is no create keyword in JavaScript for classes. Instances are created with new.
There is no create keyword in JavaScript for classes. Instances are created with new.
this
Incorrect, give it another shot!
this refers to the current instance inside a class. It does not create new instances.
this refers to the current instance inside a class. It does not create new instances.
new
Correct Answer!
Correct! new ClassName() calls the constructor and returns a fresh instance of the class.
Correct! new ClassName() calls the constructor and returns a fresh instance of the class.
static
Incorrect, give it another shot!
static defines methods on the class itself, not on instances. Use new to create instances.
